title: identity-record
description: Substrate entry binding an identity-key (public component) to a substrate entity (the holder). The record's id is the canonical-form hash of the public-key-bytes — content-derived per hash-discipline. Private keys are never substrate content.

holder.description: Reference to the substrate entity this key is bound to.

scheme.description: Signature/encryption scheme. Determines verification and encryption procedures.

public-key-bytes.description: Public component, canonical-form-encoded (typically base64 or hex).

predecessor.description: Optional cell-id of the prior identity-record this replaces (for key rotation). Predecessor chain is acyclic.
